description.narrative: PEF, will collaborate with the Coastal Municipalities Water Utility (CMWU), the organization responsible for water and sanitation services in the Palestinian Gaza Strip, and the Palestinian Water Authority (PWA) to increase the access to safe and adequate water, sanitation personal and environmental hygiene services to conflict affected communities and returnees in Gaza and North Gaza Governorates. PEF is a non-profit (non-governmental) association that provides important services in the environment andnatural resources fields to all Palestinians without discrimination. PEF has a strong track record and long-term experience working in the WASH sector and successfully supports vulnerable communities throughout the Gaza Strip to access basic WASH services. It also has substantial experience in designing and overseeing the implementation of technical water and environmental infrastructure and agriculture programmes. PEF ensures equitable, affordable, and sustainable access to safe and sufficient WASH services protecting the dignity of the unserved, underserved and most vulnerable Palestinians living under occupation in the Gaza Strip. PEF has developed a strong capacity to implement WASH, engineering, and public health activities. PEF engineers and hygiene promotion teams were involved and consulted in the design and planning of the proposed project and supported in coordinating with relevant authorities and municipalities. Additionally, PEF in partnership with Oxfam, implemented the first phase of this project funded by AECID, “Sanitation Assistance to IDP informal sites – Rafah and Khan Younes, Gaza Strip" which aims to improve safe access to lifesaving water services and improved hygiene practices to safeguard public health for conflict-affected women, men, girls and boys in the Gaza Strip. Specifically, the 9-monthinitiative includes the supplying and installation of 433 imported latrine slabs with superstructure, 81 bladders 5m3 water storage, and 78 handwashing stations, in addition to conducting cleaning services for those latrines installed, and managing and collectingup to 448 tons from solid waste. All these activities were targeted and benefited 34 makeshift camps and hosted communities locatedin Mawasi Khan Yunis and Rafah, reaching up to 130,000 BNFs. PEF has been implementing several similar projects, funded by ECHO, OCHA, the Italian Development Cooperation and many others since its establishment in 1998.

It was establishmentin 1998 by a group of Palestinian experts to meet the demand needed in the field of the environment and natural resources.The establishment of PEF enables environmental friends all over the world to cooperate neglecting geological and political constrains to stopthe negative impacts on the environment. Together, we create a universal free from pollution, sustainable and suitable for new generations. PEF practiced projects almost all over Gaza Strip. The projects activities mainly covered the following areas: Water and wastewater, public health, global warming, infrastructure and capacity building activities, compost production, solid wastes and awareness programs. The association aim is to share in improving the environmental situation in the Palestinian territories, also, to protect the local environment, and public health natural resources from pollution and mining.
